title: Ledger record: review
description: A confirmation, rejection, or requested revision (PRD §10.2, §10.8). Review is explicit and transactional: a batch confirm/reject is all-or-nothing, and a review that names a stale ledger version or frame checksum is rejected rather than applied to changed work.

data.$comment: Phase 0: payload shape is deliberately loose — properties are optional and no additionalProperties bound is set. The property names come from the PRD §10.8 review transaction.

reviewer_authority.description: The authority under which the reviewer acted, e.g. an approver group reference.

rationale.description: Why the reviewer decided this way — what they read, ran, or checked. Distinct from `comment`, which is an aside: this is the ground of the decision itself, and a confirmation without one cannot be told apart from an unread claim. The key is absent when no rationale was recorded, never present-and-empty.
